collapses_to.tool: a single idempotency-keyed ingest that takes a development-supplier inventory for a window — the agents and their vendors, the MCP servers and plugins, and an owner with a validity period — and files the suppliers and the period record together, instead of one vendor call per supplier plus an evidence create and links the client has to thread

idempotency.verified_at: Published createVendor tool description at https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp: "If a vendor with the same name already exists, the existing record is returned."

The createEvidence tool description published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp documents creating text/note/link evidence with optional control mappings and documents no idempotency key. The "Idempotency/Upsert Behavior" section of https://api.noru.tech/llms.txt covers assets and security findings only.
idempotency.gap: No idempotency key is documented for evidence, so this piece embeds a marker built from the repository slug, the window and a digest of the rendered inventory in the evidence description, and probes getOrganizationEvidence before creating. A documented key would let the probe go away.

idempotency.verified_at: The linkEvidenceToControl tool description published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp documents linking an evidence record to a control. Nothing published says whether linking the same pair twice is a no-op, so this piece does not assume it is.
idempotency.gap: The evidence id is learned from the create in the same plan, so the call carries depends_on and the executing client substitutes it; for evidence that already exists the piece compares the links the snapshot lists. A documented key on evidence would remove both probes.

source.note: The agents come from an agent-change-control manifest of the repository's own changes, and the MCP servers and plugins from its committed agent configuration — the development process's suppliers, which no server-side integration can see.
The organization's controls. Ids come from Noru; this plugin ships none.
What a control expects and what is already linked, so a person can choose which controls this inventory is evidence for. Which ones apply is Noru's answer, never this plugin's.
The vendors the organization already records, so the plan can say which suppliers already exist.

exit_codes.1: drift, validation failure, an unusable acc manifest, a missing acc manifest the committed manifest was built from, or a stale plan
exit_codes.2: usage error, including a push without --confirm
